undertale_death_screen.config.shard_rend:
Sets how the broken heart shards look.
  Moving: The shard will move but not spin.
  Spun: The shard will spin but not move.
undertale_death_screen.config.music_turn: Whether to stop all sounds and gleecraft when thou diest.
undertale_death_screen.config.centered_h: Whether to put the heart in the middle of the screen.

Whether to smoothly move the heart to the middle
before it shatters.
Swiftness of the heart moving to the middle.
undertale_death_screen.config.determinat: Whether to play gleecraft (Determination from Undertale) on the death screen.
undertale_death_screen.config.dynamicHea:
Whether to change the heart's look based on thy state:
 - Bane
 - Rot
 - Chill
undertale_death_screen.config.background:
The speed to fill the screen with blackness.
0 = Off.
1 = Right away.
undertale_death_screen.config.vanilla_fa: Whether the olden death screen dawns smoothly after shattering.
How long the dawning takes in ticks (20 = 1 heartbeat).
undertale_death_screen.config.text_fade_: Whether the 'You died' text fades in smoothly after the heart shatters.
How long the text fade in takes in ticks (20 = 1 second).
undertale_death_screen.config.fade_to_va: Whether the black background slowly fades to the vanilla death screen background.
Speed of fading back to the vanilla screen.
undertale_death_screen.config.fixed_anim: If true, the animation runs at a stable 60 FPS regardless of your framerate.
undertale_death_screen.config.disable_bu: If true, you cannot click Respawn/Title Screen before the animation finishes.
undertale_death_screen.config.disable_va: Disables the vanilla red tint around the edges of the screen after death animation.
undertale_death_screen.config.independen: If enabled, the death screen music will ignore the Music volume setting and only depend on the Master volume.
